descripcion:
HP layoffs, and what "operational efficiency" means in a filing. On Nov 22, 2022, HP filed an 8-K, the form a public company uses to report major events. It says the board approved "a plan intended to enable digital transformation, portfolio optimization and operational efficiency", with workforce reductions of approximately 4,000 to 6,000 employees by the end of fiscal 2025.

So what does "operational efficiency" mean here? In this filing, it sits in the same plan as the job cuts. Same 8-K, same paragraph.

HP's 10-K says it returned $1.1 billion to shareholders in fiscal 2023. That is about $275,000 per planned job cut (our math, at the low end of 4,000; at 6,000 it is about $183,333).

This is the 2022 plan. It is not HP's later restructuring announced in 2025.

Sources: HP 8-K, Item 2.05, filed Nov 22, 2022; HP 10-K, fiscal 2023.
